lines.text: This strawberry candy was specially made by the Cooking Oil Squad. Let me know if you need some!
I can't believe the AZX is finally taking civilians to the surface. Isn't it wonderful?
Hehe, I'll do my best to make sure you have a comfortable journey.
I hope all AZX passengers arrive at their desired destinations with only happy memories.
The Cooking Oil Squad poured their hearts into making this candy! Would you like to try some, Commander?
Don't forget, Commander, you're our most important passenger!
Do re mi... Fa... So la ti... do... Ahem... my voice is all warmed up, but I wonder where the Commander is...
Do... Do... Do... Ti la so... Fa... Mi re... Do... Hehe, I'll be here practicing my singing. Go do what you need to do.
I hope one day the Outpost can serve as a departure and arrival station connected to the surface!
I hope someday I can open a small candy store at the train station, and share my strawberry candy with everyone!

Older fooolks! Younger fooolks! Everyoneee!
Let's gooo! To the Outpost train statiooon!
Welcome aboard the AZX that spreads happiness wherever it goes! I'm truly happy to be on this journey with you, Commander!
Thanks for all the effort you put into preparing this!
Hehe, this backup is awesome!
Now I can push onward even further.
Oh my, when did you prepare all this? Thank you...
I'll return the favor with a ton of strawberry candy!
This makes me feel just as happy as when I'm eating strawberry candy!

When I'm with you, I feel as excited and happy,
as if I was riding the AZX. I love it!
I'd like to journey further and stay with you a little longer. Is... that okay?
I'm so glad I get to be with you on this long journey they call life...
Hehe, ready to depart together on the AZX?
Yep! I'm here!
Chugga chugga choo choo! All aboard!
Watch out for collisions!
Don't worry. It'll all turn out okay!
I'll protect my passengers no matter what!
I'll clear the way!
Time to regroup!
I'm okay. I'm not tired yet!
Now that I've seen you, I'm ready to go again!
It's time!
